title: C26 - Intrabar Path & Per-Trade Funding Fidelity Adjudication of the frozen crash-rebound edge
why_c26: C25 applies funding as one venue-mean scalar per venue and prices every fill at next-open on 1h bars. Two fidelity gaps remain, both capable of flipping sign on a 9%-target, multi-day-hold, short/hedged strategy: (a) funding applied per trade, per symbol, per timestamp instead of a venue mean; (b) intrabar stop/target sequencing. C26 adjudicates whether the NO_GO survives these final same-data fidelity axes.
research_question: Is the pooled spec-literal PnL sign robust to per-trade realized funding and conservative intrabar path sequencing, across four independent real venues and four folds?
blocked_on: C25-T1 (round-trip cost & realized-funding fidelity). C26 build may proceed before C25 passes, but no C26 cell may run until C25 ACCEPTANCE: PASS and the C25 primary-arm per-venue/per-fold PnL is available as the path_base fidelity anchor.

signal_path_frozen.drift_rule: Any artifact whose signal_path/cost fields differ from this prereg are INVALID.

path_base.why: Exact C25 primary-arm model (venue-mean scalar funding, next-open fills). MUST reproduce the C25 cost_taker_funding per-venue/per-fold PnL within +/-1.0 (PATH_ANCHOR_REPRODUCED, else PATH_ANCHOR_MISMATCH).

path_funding_trade.why: Per-trade, per-symbol, per-timestamp realized 8h funding from the acquired venue funding caches (every held hour on every leg; longs pay when rate > 0, shorts receive). okx is UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING.

path_intrabar_adverse_first.why: Conservative intrabar sequencing: within a 1h bar that touches both the stop and the target (or liquidation), the adverse extreme is assumed to print first (stop/liquidation before target).

path_intrabar_combined.why: Per-trade realized funding AND conservative intrabar sequencing together — the C26 primary adjudication arm.

arms_rule: ONLY intrabar_adverse_first / per_trade_funding vary across arms. All other config fields (signal path + liquidation distance + cost model) are identical and drift-checked. path_base is the FIDELITY_ANCHOR; path_intrabar_combined is the PRIMARY adjudication arm. All four arms run the full 4 venues x 4 folds x 20k bootstrap / 20k permutation / 2k placebo — no smoke arm, no reduced draw floors, no descriptive-only arm.

inference.pooled: venue-blocked bootstrap over the 16 (venue, fold) cell totals (20000 draws)

multiplicity.family: primary arm path_intrabar_combined, 4 folds x 4 venues = 16 permutation tests

fidelity_anchor.reference: C25 primary-arm (cost_taker_funding) per-venue/per-fold PnL from research_state/c25_decision_verdict_cost_taker_funding_20261119T045500Z.json (venue_totals). Available only after C25 ACCEPTANCE: PASS.
fidelity_anchor.rule: path_base must reproduce the C25 primary-arm per-venue/per-fold PnL within +/-1.0; otherwise C26 is UNDERPOWERED and no verdict may be issued.

funding_acquisition.rule: A venue without realized funding history is recorded UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING (never zero-filled) and the realistic arms are evaluated on the remaining venues; okx is UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING by API retention (33-day window).

decision_rules.C26_REOPENS_C1_C25: ALL of, under path_intrabar_combined (PRIMARY): (a) pooled total PnL > 0; (b) venue-blocked bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0; (c) >= 1 BH survivor in the 16-test path_intrabar_combined family; (d) >= 3 of 4 folds positive; (e) >= 3 of 4 venues positive (available venue set; okx excluded from funding arms so binance_um, mexc, bitget must all be positive). Then the C1-C25 NO_GO is NOT robust to path/funding fidelity: record SUPERSEDED_BY_C26 and the edge is re-opened.
decision_rules.C26_NO_GO_ROBUST_TO_PATH: ANY of (a)-(e) fails under path_intrabar_combined. Then the NO_GO survives per-trade funding and intrabar path fidelity and is strengthened: record C1-C26 NO_GO ROBUST TO MARGIN, COST AND PATH; same-data fidelity work is CLOSED (only new-venue data or the CLOSED Hyperliquid-native acquisition remain).
decision_rules.C26_UNDERPOWERED: Path anchor mismatch, prereg generated after any compute artifact, draw floors not met, missing artifacts, or signal-path/cost/intrabar drift.
decision_rules.rule: Both REOPENS and NO_GO_ROBUST are terminal and must be reported with the full arm x venue x fold table, per-leg attribution and exit-reason decomposition. Never report a bare token. C26 is not a GO search: no configuration search, no additional thresholds, no new venues beyond the four.

checkpoint_rule: A (arm, venue, fold) is DONE only when research_state/c26_ckpt_<arm>_<venue>_<fold>_20261119T121500Z.json exists. Resume with --resume; never relaunch completed folds.

provenance.caveat: Real exchange USDT-perp data, non-synthetic, CROSS-VENUE vs the Hyperliquid spec; NEVER Hyperliquid performance evidence and never relabelled as such.

guardrails: No synthetic gap-fill; no spec relaxation of RSI/target/hold/sizing/volume/gross cap.
C26 varies only funding granularity and intrabar sequencing; liquidation distance fixed at the C24 primary; cost model frozen at the C25 primary.
No additional venues or folds beyond those pre-registered.
Artifacts are immutable once written; do not edit completed campaign outputs.
No C26 cell runs until C25 ACCEPTANCE: PASS (C26 is blocked on C25 completion).
